resources.string: Clears local sign-ins to recover credentials. Lessons remain; remote access is not revoked.

Remove all local ChatGPT sign-ins? Lessons remain, but these connections will no longer generate. Remote access is not revoked; disconnect the app in ChatGPT settings. Signing in again creates a new registration.
Could not load models. Check your connection and refresh.
Finish sign-in in your browser. If the app closes or five minutes pass, sign in again.
%1$s\nPlan access isn’t authorized. Continue with ChatGPT to review permissions.
Signed out. Local tokens removed; registration kept for next sign-in.
Local sign-in cleared. Remote revocation unconfirmed; disconnect the app in ChatGPT settings via Manage usage.
Eligible requests use your ChatGPT allowance or credits. Manage usage shows access and limits. API billing requires an explicit switch.
ChatGPT usage limit reached. Check Manage usage. No switch to API billing.
ChatGPT plan access is unavailable for this account or workspace policy. Repeated sign-ins won’t remove this restriction.
ChatGPT plan temporarily unavailable. Connection kept; no switch to API billing. Try later.
Unsupported ChatGPT plan request. An app update is needed; don’t retry this request.
ChatGPT plan permission is missing or invalid. Reauthorize this connection in Settings → Providers & models.
Sign in again for this connection in Settings → Providers & models. No switch to API billing.
ChatGPT response exceeded the app’s size limit, not your plan quota. Connections kept. Check for an app update.
